question.text: All exchange-traded currency options in India are settled how?

answer.text: Cash settled in Indian Rupees on T+2 basis
Physical delivery of currency on T+1 basis
Either cash or physical at buyer's choice

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 88 of the source states that INR currency options are cash settled in Indian Rupees with final settlement on T+2; page 89 says the same for cross-currency options; page 166 confirms that all exchange-traded currency derivatives contracts are currently cash settled in Indian Rupees with final settlement on T+2. The Trap: Physical delivery on T+1, optional cash/physical at buyer's choice, and USD-denominated cash settlement are not the regime SEBI/exchanges operate for these contracts. Note: Page 80 supports the broader point that the cash-settled buyer receives the profit amount on settlement.
